generationSource: Deterministic repository-authored examples; no runtime capture.
correlationIdPolicy: Ephemeral operational identifier only; never a user, campaign, attribution, or ad-platform join key.

ownerIsolationPolicy.ownerSource: Authenticated bearer identity only; owner identifiers are never accepted from request input.
ownerIsolationPolicy.inaccessibleCatalogBehavior: Missing, archived, and entitlement-inaccessible lessons or activities use the same resource_not_found response.
ownerIsolationPolicy.accountSwitch: Cancel or ignore prior-owner responses, clear owner-scoped caches, and revalidate identity before rendering new-owner data.

billingProjectionPolicy: Billing status is display and routing data. Clients must use server-projected accessGranted and entitlements and must never infer access from the subscription status enum.

delayed_read.expected: Show a semantic loading state after the client threshold; never invent data or spin indefinitely.

read_timeout_before_headers.expected: Cancel, preserve last confirmed state, and offer an actionable retry.

user_or_navigation_cancellation.expected: Cancel cleanly without an error announcement.

offline_before_request.expected: Make no request and show the offline state with a safe retry.

disconnect_mid_read.expected: Preserve confirmed state and retry only after reconnect.

ambiguous_attempt_timeout.expected: Retain the same UUID v4 Idempotency-Key and reconcile or retry only that logical write.

reconnect.expected: Revalidate identity and owner-scoped data before rendering ready state.

account_switch_in_flight.expected: Cancel or ignore previous-owner responses, clear owner caches, and fetch the new owner.

late_response_after_cancellation.expected: Discard deterministically without overwriting current state.
